method: Face-varying UV rasterization; calibrated pinhole projection; reviewed tissue-mask, positive-depth, metric-depth-consistency, and front-face checks; cosine-weighted multi-view fusion in linear light.
required_inputs: Metric camera-Z depth aligned to each RGB frame
Registration between the tracked surface mesh and camera frames

tests: Registered plane color is baked to expected UV texels
Two views fuse in linear-light space and report overlap

appendix300_application.reason: The locally audited Appendix300 clip provides RGB only; no calibrated metric depth or mesh-to-video registration is available. Prior SAM2 masks are provisional and drift rapidly.

texture_semantics: Observed RGB after geometric registration; not intrinsic albedo, BRDF, or confirmation of appendix identity.
privacy: No raw video, image, mask, depth frame, camera pose, or personal information is written by the tracked implementation or report. All synthetic test inputs are generated in memory.
